plushpal.ui.turn_every_plush_animation_o: Turn every plush animation on or off

plushpal.ui.size_when_worn_on_the_head: Size when worn on the head
plushpal.ui.move_the_plush_left_or_right: Move the plush left or right

plushpal.ui.move_the_plush_forward_or_ba: Move the plush forward or back

plushpal.ui.play_animations_when_worn_on: Play animations when worn on the head
plushpal.ui.turn_this_animation_on_or_of: Turn this animation on or off

plushpal.ui.use_the_narrower_arm_layout_: Use the narrower arm layout when your skin is slim (Alex)
plushpal.ui.look_the_username_up_again_f: Look the username up again (for when the player changed their skin)
